r11_body_reference.scale_source: Original goal-position radius; bound reference lead throughout outbound/return without moving the original endpoints.

r12_stable_support.actual_support: Same R10ContactNormal/rest for material; actual candidate native foot-ground forces elsewhere. No airborne foot contributes force.
r12_stable_support.support_transfer: Phase shares request foot loads and bounded loaded heights; total load and roll/pitch moments use actual candidate forces. Geometric placement remains informative above contact.
r12_stable_support.impact: positive(hold*max(-vz,0)+max(-vz,0)^2/(2*g)-(bottom_z+.0008))/.0002; one-g braking scale is a soft viability target, not a guaranteed deceleration.
r12_stable_support.weights_basis: Unit normalized support/placement costs; ImpactMargin uses existing 176-node material-domain normalization. Existing weights unchanged.

r12_substep_path.residual: Componentwise maximum over all ten .2ms pre-step states of each held2msinterval; terminal node separately retained.
r12_substep_path.derivatives: Cj*prefix_A and Cj*prefix_B+Dj at the same earliest maximizing substep; A/B compose all ten transitions.
r12_substep_path.limitations: Nonsmooth active-substep switch uses an active-branch Jacobian. Frozen-anchor candidate force is not future TM02 truth; soft costs cannot guarantee plant feasibility.

retained: Original robot, materials/strain.02, task, torque, collision/fall limits, frozen causal PANN, PPO/observation and speed-cap dimensions.
qualification: No pretraining qualification gate; ensuing real joint training and fixed final evaluation supply evidence.

build_record.initial_compile: An unused floor variable after the shared-force refactor was rejected by -Werror; removed before successful build. Initial log retained with controller artifacts.
